client/src/components/integrations/Confi.name: Organization setting overrides
client/src/components/integrations/Confi.description: Lists the settings one organization has changed from the shared defaults and lets an admin adjust them.

client/src/components/integrations/Confi.name: Override row
client/src/components/integrations/Confi.description: Shows one organization's changed setting, what it now is, and the actions available on it.

client/src/components/integrations/Creat.name: Connect a service
client/src/components/integrations/Creat.description: Walks an admin through adding a service the platform can talk to, including its sign-in details.

client/src/components/integrations/Entit.name: Pick a matching record
client/src/components/integrations/Entit.description: Offers likely matches for a record that needs linking, so an admin can accept one instead of typing an ID.

client/src/components/integrations/Entit.name: Record picker
client/src/components/integrations/Entit.description: Lets an admin search the records a connection offers and pick one, or type an ID instead.

client/src/components/integrations/Gener.name: Generated connection summary
client/src/components/integrations/Gener.description: Summarises the ready-made code produced for a connection, with a copy button.

client/src/components/integrations/Gener.name: Generate connection code
client/src/components/integrations/Gener.description: Creates ready-made code for a service connection so automations can call it without extra setup.

client/src/components/integrations/Integ.name: Shared connection defaults
client/src/components/integrations/Integ.description: Sets the default values every organization inherits for a connection.

client/src/components/integrations/Integ.name: Remove a connection
client/src/components/integrations/Integ.description: Confirms before removing a connection and keeps it on screen until the removal succeeds.

client/src/components/integrations/Integ.name: Organization mappings
client/src/components/integrations/Integ.description: Links each organization to its own account in a connected service so records land in the right place.

client/src/components/integrations/Integ.name: Connection overview
client/src/components/integrations/Integ.description: Shows a connection's status, sign-in state and which organizations use it.

client/src/components/integrations/Integ.name: Connection page header
client/src/components/integrations/Integ.description: Shows a connection's name and status with its main actions at the top of its page.

client/src/components/integrations/Integ.name: Connection load error
client/src/components/integrations/Integ.description: Explains that a connection could not be loaded and offers to try again.

client/src/components/integrations/Integ.name: Connection field list
client/src/components/integrations/Integ.description: Edits the list of setup questions a connection asks and which of them are required.

client/src/components/integrations/Integ.name: Test a connection
client/src/components/integrations/Integ.description: Sends a live test through a connection so an admin can confirm the sign-in details work.

client/src/components/integrations/Integ.name: Test result
client/src/components/integrations/Integ.description: Shows whether a connection test succeeded, with the reply from the service.

client/src/components/integrations/Manua.name: Type a record ID
client/src/components/integrations/Manua.description: Lets an admin enter a record's ID by hand when searching for it is not possible.

client/src/components/integrations/mappi.name: Mapping save results
client/src/components/integrations/mappi.description: Works out which organizations failed to link so the screen can name them and their reasons.

client/src/components/integrations/Match.name: Suggested match
client/src/components/integrations/Match.description: Shows a suggested match with how confident it is, and lets an admin accept or reject it.

client/src/components/integrations/OrgCo.name: Organization connection settings
client/src/components/integrations/OrgCo.description: Sets one organization's own settings and account for a shared connection.

client/src/components/integrations/Overr.name: Override value editor
client/src/components/integrations/Overr.description: Edits the value an organization uses instead of the shared default.

client/src/components/mcp/MCPServerForm..name: AI assistant connection
client/src/components/mcp/MCPServerForm..description: Sets up a connection AI assistants can use, starting by finding what the outside system offers.

client/src/components/oauth/CreateOAuthC.name: Add a sign-in connection
client/src/components/oauth/CreateOAuthC.description: Connects an outside service through its normal sign-in screen so the platform can act for that account.

client/src/components/oauth/OAuthConnect.name: Sign-in connection card
client/src/components/oauth/OAuthConnect.description: Shows one connected account, whether it still works, and offers reconnect or disconnect.

client/src/components/oauth/OAuthProvide.name: Sign-in provider setup
client/src/components/oauth/OAuthProvide.description: Fills in the details a service needs before people can connect their accounts to it.

client/src/components/oauth/RefreshJobSt.name: Connection refresh status
client/src/components/oauth/RefreshJobSt.description: Reports how a bulk reconnection or sign-in refresh is going and what is left.

client/src/components/policy-rules/Polic.name: Policy rule actions
client/src/components/policy-rules/Polic.description: Offers edit and delete for a named policy rule.

client/src/components/policy-rules/Polic.name: Policy rules
client/src/components/policy-rules/Polic.description: Creates and maintains named rules that decide who may read or change records in a table.

client/src/components/policy-rules/Polic.name: Policy rule panel
client/src/components/policy-rules/Polic.description: Frames the policy rules list with its loading, empty and error states.

client/src/components/reports/formatters.name: Report formatting
client/src/components/reports/formatters.description: Turns usage numbers into readable dates, money, file sizes and durations for the reports.

client/src/components/reports/report-csv.name: Report download
client/src/components/reports/report-csv.description: Builds a spreadsheet file of a usage report and downloads it, keeping labels intact.

client/src/components/reports/ReportReco.name: Compact report records
client/src/components/reports/ReportReco.description: Shows each report entry on phones without hiding any of its figures.

client/src/components/reports/UsageChart.name: Usage charts
client/src/components/reports/UsageChart.description: Draws the trends behind usage and spending over the chosen period.

client/src/components/reports/UsageSumma.name: Usage summary cards
client/src/components/reports/UsageSumma.description: Shows the headline usage and cost totals for the period at the top of the report.

client/src/components/reports/UsageTable.name: Usage tables
client/src/components/reports/UsageTable.description: Breaks usage and cost down by workflow, agent, conversation, organization and stored knowledge.

client/src/components/roles/ConsumerCard.name: Role usage cards
client/src/components/roles/ConsumerCard.description: Summarises how many people and organizations hold a role.

client/src/components/roles/ConsumerTab..name: Who holds a role
client/src/components/roles/ConsumerTab..description: Lists the people, identities and organizations a role applies to, with where each one uses it.

client/src/components/roles/RoleDeleteDi.name: Delete role
client/src/components/roles/RoleDeleteDi.description: Confirms before deleting a role and warns what its holders will lose.

client/src/components/roles/RoleDetailHe.name: Role page header
client/src/components/roles/RoleDetailHe.description: Shows a role's name and description above its permissions and holders.

client/src/components/roles/RoleDialog.t.name: Role editor
client/src/components/roles/RoleDialog.t.description: Creates or edits a role's name and description.
